say:2:1460127001:0.text: When we first met, I thought your swordsmanship had reached its pinnacle.
say:2:1460127001:0.source_cn: 我原本以为当年见面时，你的剑法已经登峰造极了。

say:3:1460127002:1.text: But then you wrote of mastering the wind and ice swords, and my spirit burned with desire to follow.
say:3:1460127002:1.source_cn: 但后来你写信说，你在操控风与冰的双剑上又取得了进展，我...

say:4:1460127003:0.text: Yet now, I see you have risen even higher... beyond what I imagined.
say:4:1460127003:0.source_cn: 没想到，你居然还能更进一步。

say:5:1460127004:1.text: Experience, learn, and challenge your limits. With the right guidance and opportunity, you too will find your path, Pang.
say:5:1460127004:1.source_cn: 积累，学习，挑战——以及一些引导和契机，你也能办得到，潘。

say:6:1460127005:0.text: I feel that you are standing on the edge of your transformation, like a butterfly yet to unfurl its wings.
say:6:1460127005:0.source_cn: 我已经感觉到了，你就像是即将破茧的蝴蝶一样，酝酿着无比...

say:7:1460127006:1.text: I cannot help but envy your journey with <style="stress"><player_name></style>, meeting warriors from every corner of Esperia.
say:7:1460127006:1.source_cn: 而且，我也很羡慕你，能在<style=stress><...
say:7:1460127006:1.male: I cannot help but envy your journey with <style="stress"><player_name></style>, meeting warriors from every corner of Esperia.
say:7:1460127006:1.female: I cannot help but envy your journey with <style="stress"><player_name></style>, meeting warriors from every corner of Esperia.

say:10:1460127007:1.text: You're just in time, Eironn. We haven't told you about our latest plans for the tournament yet.
say:10:1460127007:1.source_cn: 正好，埃隆，我们还没和你讲最新的大赛计划呢！

choice_prompt:11:1460127007.text: You're just in time, Eironn. We haven't told you about our latest plans for the tournament yet.
choice_prompt:11:1460127007.source_cn: 正好，埃隆，我们还没和你讲最新的大赛计划呢！

say:12:1460127008:0.text: A grand tournament with regional qualifying matches... How interesting...
say:12:1460127008:0.source_cn: 盛大的武斗大赛，与各地特色的预选赛……实在是很有意思。

say:13:1460127010:0.text: Well... if you all have confirmed the tournament schedule, then I'm afraid I won't be staying here to host the qualifiers.
say:13:1460127010:0.source_cn: 嗯……如果你们确定了赛程，那我恐怕不会留在这里主持预选。

say:14:1460127011:1.text: I will begin here, travel far and wide to join the preliminary matches and gather the proof of my victories along the way.
say:14:1460127011:1.source_cn: 正好回来了，应该就会从此处出发，去游历各地，参加所有的...

say:17:1460127012:1.text: Indeed, that is my plan as well. Let us meet at the main tournament, and we will finally have our duel.
say:17:1460127012:1.source_cn: 我也是这么打算的，朋友，到时候就在大赛上相会，再正式比武吧。

say:18:1460127013:1.text: Then you must quickly understand yourself and the powers you possess, or else the tournament will slip away.
say:18:1460127013:1.source_cn: 前提是你要赶紧悟出自己的招式，否则就要错过比赛了。

say:19:1460127014:1.text: Eironn and Pang exchange a knowing smile, while Lyca's heavy sigh cuts through the air beside them.
say:19:1460127014:1.source_cn: 埃隆与潘相视而笑，旁边传来了莱卡响亮的叹气声。

say:22:1460127015:1.text: I knew you couldn't just stay at home long and now you're not even going to take responsibility for the qualifiers...
say:22:1460127015:1.source_cn: 我就知道，你不可能在家里待着，结果连预选赛都不想负责。

say:23:1460127016:1.text: *Sigh* It's fine... We knew it would end up this way.
say:23:1460127016:1.source_cn: 算了，反正我们早就知道你会这样。

choice_prompt:24:1460127016.text: *Sigh* It's fine... We knew it would end up this way.
choice_prompt:24:1460127016.source_cn: 算了，反正我们早就知道你会这样。

say:25:1460127017:1.text: Ordinary warriors will undergo the basic screening process while the qualifying rounds will be conducted by me, Parisa, and Bryon in turn.
say:25:1460127017:1.source_cn: 普通的队员进行基本筛选，而资格赛就由我、帕瑞莎和布莱恩...

say:26:1460127018:1.text: However, the specific schedule and plan may still require everyone's assistance.
say:26:1460127018:1.source_cn: 不过，具体的赛程和计划恐怕还要借助你们的智慧呢。

say:27:1460127019:1.text: How about we all head to Lunadorf together and talk about it over Granny Dahnie's special soup?
say:27:1460127019:1.source_cn: 我们就一起去月湖村，一边喝婆婆的汤，一边讨论吧！

choice:24:0:1.male: Do you have a plan already?
choice:24:0:1.female: Do you have a plan already?

say:30:1460127009:1.text: I've no interest in winning the tournament, but I do want to meet all the top warriors from around the world.
say:30:1460127009:1.source_cn: 我对争夺比赛胜负并无兴趣，但我确实想要见识各地的高手。
